div.head: Quadr Ded 36
div.ab: Nobis cor ingrauatum est, ingenium hebes et agreste balbutium, quo uel idoneam Ciceronis copiam uel præcipitem Aristotilis breuitatem uel Nasonis sobriam siccitatem uel floridum Statii cultum uel Uirgilianam omnium permixtionem recte, argute, ornate distinguere uel distincta permiscere cognouerim.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 532 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
